Generated seccomp filter allowing write and fsync only on logfile_fd.

# Purpose
A generated C header defines a seccomp BPF filter for the `fd_gossip_tile` component. It includes the Linux seccomp and BPF headers, selects the target architecture with `ARCH_NR`, and sets the filter length in `sock_filter_policy_fd_gossip_tile_instr_cnt`. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_gossip_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_gossip_tile>) function fills a `sock_filter` array with rules that allow only `write` and `fsync` system calls, and only when the file descriptor argument matches `logfile_fd` for the log file or standard error for `write`. All other system calls end with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`, so the process stops if it makes a call outside this policy.
